edge.definitions:
A closed trade = everything one player did in one market this season, once nothing is left open there.
- Expected edge, Polymarket: (your forecast - price paid - taker fee) per share. No forecast sent = forecast is the
  price, so expected edge is just minus the fee.
- Expected edge, memecoins: what the fill gave up against Jupiter's reference price at entry (impact + fees), per $.
- Realized edge: closed P&L per share (Polymarket) or per $ put in (memecoins).
- R-multiple: closed P&L / money put in. 1R = the whole stake, because a Polymarket share or a memecoin can go to 0
  and the Arena has no stop orders. -1.0R = lost everything; +0.05R = made 5% of the stake.
Bands: Polymarket by average entry price; memecoins by the pool they entered (launch curve, small pool, large pool).
